The caterer does not publish a delivery fee, radius, or order cutoff.

fee.reason: No published delivery fee. A flat $50 within 15 miles plus $2.50 per mile is a simple LA-area model.

radius.reason: No published radius. 25 miles from Koreatown covers Culver City and the core LA basin.

service_charge.reason: The menu is drop-off catering and publishes no service charge.

notes: The source PDF marks set-menu prices as '+ tax'.
The rate follows the delivery address, not the caterer's neighborhood.

allergens.note: No published allergen table. Every menu item is marked unknown. Flag any allergy request for caterer confirmation.

dietary.note: Only items explicitly labeled veg. are tagged vegetarian. Confirm all other dietary requests.

capacity.note: The capacity calendar is invented for the demo and is not part of the caterer's published rules.

assumptions: Display name is anonymized to 'Koreatown Catering Co.'; prices and items remain real.
Minimum order is 5 guests, based on the smallest published set menu.
Delivery fee is $50 flat within 15 miles, then $2.50 per mile to a 25-mile maximum.
Tax follows the delivery address: Culver City 11.25%, Torrance 10.75%.
Tax base includes food and delivery; gratuity is excluded.
Piece-count items assume 2-3 pieces per guest.
One pound of raw LA galbi assumes 3-4 servings.
All allergens are unknown because the caterer publishes no allergen table.
Dietary tags are limited to items explicitly labeled veg.
